name: Blinky
description: A GeoGuessr-style minigame for Geometry Dash. See a random level fragment, identify the level, find the exact location!

flash-duration-ms.name: Flash Duration (ms)
flash-duration-ms.description: How long the fragment is shown. Minimum is one frame (~16ms).

fragment-width-blocks.name: Fragment Width (blocks)
fragment-width-blocks.description: Width of the shown fragment in blocks.

fragment-height-blocks.name: Fragment Height (blocks)
fragment-height-blocks.description: Height of the shown fragment in blocks.

difficulty.name: Difficulty
difficulty.description: Easy = longer flash. Normal = standard. Hard = very short flash.

include-tower-levels.name: Include Tower/Secret Levels
include-tower-levels.description: Include The Tower, Sewers, Cellar, etc.

wrong-level-penalty.name: Wrong Level Penalty
wrong-level-penalty.description: Add extra penalty points for selecting the wrong level.
